title: Backoffice employee change UI omits implemented contact fields and clear controls
actualError: EmployeeChangeForm.vue lacks the canonical mobile contact label

contractProof.backendOwner: BackofficeManagementService resolves and persists all three contacts with explicit clear flags
contractProof.uiCurrentState: The form initializes only clear flags and exposes none of the contact values or clear controls.

rootCause: The DTO/model and backend contact contract were completed but the developer-facing employee form remained a partial projection, so a user cannot submit or intentionally clear those fields.
repairPolicy: Expose email, mobile and office phone inputs plus explicit clear controls in the canonical EmployeeChangeForm; keep the typed generated API path and backend semantics unchanged.
sourceFix: EmployeeChangeForm initializes and binds all three contact values, disables a value input when its explicit clear flag is selected, exposes all three clear controls, requires the backend-required organization, and mirrors the five-character reason validation in HTML.
verification: Contact parity and live golden path PASS; TypeScript PASS; mounted component behavior is exercised; 2 Vitest files and 6 tests PASS; Vite production build PASS with 54 modules.
passCriteria: Every optional contact has an explicit clear control
